eps.o: The SuperKitties must stop Lab Rat from chasing cats with her mega-mouse.
The SuperKitties visit Willa in the Wild Jungle.
Zsa-Zsa disguises herself as the Tooth Fairy so she can steal Bitsy's tooth and get a present.
The SuperKitties save Kittydale from Lab Rat's stinky muffins.
When Zsa-Zsa steals all the pet beds in Kittydale, the SuperKitties and Willa race to get them back.
The Glamsters make a glittery mess in the jungle as they look for a unicorn.
The SuperKitties must stop the Glamsters from stealing all the veggies in Kittydale.
The SuperKitties save Kittydale from Lab Rat's purple Octo-Gummies.
The SuperKitties must stop Zsa-Zsa from stealing all the pink items in Kittydale!
Mr. Puppypaws and Cat Burglar compete to see who is the best baddie in town.
The Kitties must save Kittydale's Halloween candy from Lab Rat's Franken-Rat robot.
The Kitties stop Mr. Puppypaws from spoiling Kittydale's Pumpkin Parade.
The Kitties and Willa stop Mr. Puppypaws from stealing a special duckie diamond hidden in the Wild Jungle.
The SuperKitties and Willa help Zsa-Zsa, who says she saw a monster.
While Willa and her hero friends wait for evening when a special flower blooms, dark clouds hang over the area.
When Cat Burglar takes what looks like a colored rock for a souvenir as a remembrance for his visit to the jungle with his granny, a large bird goes hysterical in the place.
The Kitties save Kittydale's stolen Christmas tree from the Glamsters.
The SuperKitties stop Cat Burglar from stealing the medals from a big ice-skating contest.
Things don't go as planned when the Glamsters go glamping and Buddy sleeps over at Willa's Treehouse.
The Kitties and Willa stop Mr. Puppypaws from taking over the Wild Jungle.
Lab Rat tricks Wiggles, the robot pig, into taking things and it's up to the SuperKitties to stop them!
Cat Burglar and Cousin Sassy make a mess in the jungle.
When Lab Rat steals the Clamshell Coaster for Otto's family, the Superkitties must get it back.
The Kitties help the jungle animals when Zsa-Zsa blocks a waterfall to make a spa.
When Lab Rat's Burbles steal all the bubble bath, the SuperKitties must save bathtime!
The Kitties and Willa pounce to the rescue when Cat Burglar swipes stuffies around town!
Willa helps the SuperKitties stop Mr. Puppypaws from taking a special fish statue.
The Kitties must save the first day of school when the Glamsters steal all the backpacks!
Someone steals the Kitty Copter!
When Cat Burglar and Cousin Sassy hide in a statue to swipe Amara's tiara for Granny, the SuperKitties pounce to stop them.
Zsa-Zsa takes her Aunt Lola on a picnic, where she makes all the park animals start to float away.
Mr. Puppypaws puts the Zoomie Zone in a giant fishbowl for King Fishyfins.
The Glamsters make their own supersuits!
When the Glamsters steal an outer space exhibit for a sick Evie, the Kitties must get it back!
When Zsa-Zsa doesn't want Aunt Lola to leave Kittydale, she tries turning the Wild Jungle into a wintery mess!
The Kitties must stop Lab Rat from making everyone dance!
Mr. Puppypaws sends the SuperKitties on a wild stroller chase through Kittydale.
Zsa-Zsa steals the Glamster's ball to shield George from getting another boo-boo.
It's up to the Kitties to stop a baby elephant on the loose!
The SuperKitties and Willa step in when Mr. Puppypaws' glam new look gets out of control.
The SuperKitties invite Willa to officially join them on the team after putting her skills to the test when Cat Burglar and the Glamsters team up to take over Kittydale.
The SuperKitties stop Cat Burglar from spoiling two special parties when he steals a cake.
The Kitties help Willa calm her Zoomies and save the Singing Squirrels' concert.
When the Howl-o-ween Cat's charm is stolen, a group of Trixters escapes into Kittydale. The SuperKitties must put the Trixters back in the charm before their tricks ruin Howl-o-ween.
